admission.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria (DSE)
content: **Admission Score Formula**: Any Best 5 Subjects (plus 6th subject bonus).
**Average HKDSE Score with Subject Weighting**: 178.4 (2025 JUPAS data).
**Median Admission Score**: N/A (2025 JUPAS data).
**Lower Quartile**: N/A (2025 JUPAS data).
**Subject Weighting**: Subject weighting in details.
**Core Subjects Minimum Level**: Chinese Language 3, English Language 3, Mathematics (Compulsory Part) 2, Citizenship and Social Development Attained.
**Elective Subjects**: ANY 2 SUBJECTS at Level 3.
**Interview**: No interview required for standard JUPAS admission.
**Duration**: 4 years full-time.
**First Year Tuition**: HK$44,500 (local students).
**Note**: Subject weightings apply. See "Weightings" for details.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: BEng in Environmental Engineering and Sustainable Development (JS3375) is a 4-year full-time programme under the Faculty of Construction and Environment, focusing on environmental protection, pollution control, and sustainable infrastructure.

**Year 1 – Foundation**: Students take core subjects in mathematics, chemistry, physics, engineering mechanics, and introductory environmental engineering. Includes a university-wide General University Requirements (GUR) component.

**Year 2 – Core Disciplines**: Key courses include water and wastewater engineering, air pollution control, solid waste management, environmental microbiology, and hydrology. Students begin laboratory-based learning.

**Year 3 – Specialisation & WIE**: Advanced topics such as environmental impact assessment, renewable energy systems, sustainable design, and green building. Students undertake a mandatory Work-Integrated Education (WIE) placement.

**Year 4 – Capstone & Electives**: Final-year capstone project on a real-world environmental challenge, plus elective streams in either environmental engineering or sustainable development. Students also complete a professional ethics module.
**Accreditation**: The programme is accredited by the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE), paving the way for Chartered Engineer status.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **Environmental Engineer**: Design and supervise pollution control systems, water treatment plants, and waste management facilities in both public and private sectors.
**Sustainability Consultant**: Advise corporations and government bodies on carbon reduction strategies, ESG reporting, and green building certifications (e.g., BEAM Plus, LEED).
**Government Engineer**: Join the Environmental Protection Department (EPD) or Drainage Services Department as a graduate engineer, working on Hong Kong’s environmental infrastructure.
**Researcher / Academic**: Pursue MPhil/PhD at PolyU or overseas universities, specialising in areas like air quality modelling, renewable energy, or climate change adaptation.
**Project Manager**: Lead large-scale environmental projects for engineering consultancies such as Arup, AECOM, or Mott MacDonald, particularly in the Greater Bay Area.
**Green Building Specialist**: Work with developers and architects to integrate sustainable design principles into new construction and retrofitting projects.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, directly connected to Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and Tuen Ma Line), making commuting convenient from all parts of Hong Kong.

**State-of-the-Art Labs**: Students have access to dedicated environmental engineering laboratories, including the Water and Wastewater Laboratory, Air Quality Laboratory, and the Environmental Microbiology Laboratory.
**Sustainability Hub**: The university’s Jockey Club Innovation Tower and the newly built PolyU House feature green roofs, energy-efficient systems, and serve as living labs for sustainable design.

**Student Organisations**: Join the PolyU Environmental Engineering Society, which organises site visits to sewage treatment plants, recycling centres, and eco-parks, plus networking events with industry professionals.
**Sports & Recreation**: The campus offers a sports centre with a swimming pool, gym, multi-purpose courts, and the iconic PolyU Sports Hall. Students can also join over 100 clubs and societies.

**Global Exchange**: PolyU has partnerships with over 400 institutions worldwide. Environmental engineering students can spend one semester abroad at universities in the UK, Australia, Canada, or Mainland China.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)
**Admission Score Formula**: Any Best 5 Subjects (plus 6th subject bonus). The programme considers the best 5 HKDSE subjects, with an additional bonus for a 6th subject, encouraging breadth of study.

**Subject Weighting**: Core subjects (English, Mathematics, Liberal Studies) and electives such as Chemistry, Physics, Biology, and M1/M2 receive higher weighting. Specific weighting details are available on the PolyU admissions website.
**Average Weighted Score (2025)**: The average HKDSE score with subject weighting for 2025 entry is 178.4. This serves as a benchmark for applicants to assess their competitiveness.

**No Published Median/Quartile**: As the programme is relatively new or has limited data, median and lower quartile scores for 2025 are not available. Applicants should aim for a weighted score above 178 to be competitive.

**Interview Requirement**: Shortlisted applicants may be invited for an interview, which assesses motivation, understanding of environmental issues, and communication skills. Strong performance can boost admission chances.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Success Stories
content: **Ir Dr. Albert Chan (陳國強教授)**: Former Dean of Faculty of Construction and Environment, PolyU. Renowned researcher in construction waste management and sustainable building. Graduated from PolyU’s environmental engineering programme.

**Ir Dr. Sam Hui (許志堅博士)**: Associate Professor at PolyU and expert in building energy efficiency and renewable energy. Received multiple teaching awards and leads the Sustainable Building Research Group.
**Ir Dr. Joseph Lai (黎志強博士)**: Associate Head of Department of Building Services Engineering, PolyU. Specialises in indoor air quality and energy performance. Published over 100 research papers.
**Ir Dr. Daniel Ho (何志強博士)**: Technical Director at AECOM Hong Kong, leading environmental impact assessments for major infrastructure projects. PolyU environmental engineering graduate.
**Ir Dr. Vincent Cheng (鄭振華博士)**: Chief Engineer at the Hong Kong Environmental Protection Department, overseeing air quality monitoring and policy implementation. Alumnus of PolyU.
**Ir Dr. William Yu (余偉強博士)**: Founder and CEO of a green technology startup focusing on water purification systems. Named one of Hong Kong’s top young entrepreneurs. PolyU graduate.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: **PolyU Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to HKDSE top performers (e.g., 5** in multiple subjects). Covers full or partial tuition fees for the first year, with potential renewal based on academic performance.
**Faculty of Construction and Environment Scholarship**: Specific to students in the faculty, based on HKDSE results and interview performance. Amount varies, typically HK$10,000–HK$30,000.

**Environmental Engineering Programme Scholarship**: Donated by industry partners (e.g., Arup, Drainage Services Department). Awarded to students with outstanding academic results and commitment to environmental sustainability.

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE) Bursary**: Financial support for students undertaking unpaid WIE placements, ensuring all students can gain valuable work experience regardless of financial background.

**Government Student Finance**: Eligible students can apply for the HKSAR Government’s Extended Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (ENLS) and means-tested grants/subsidies through the Student Finance Office (SFO).

**External Scholarships**: Students are encouraged to apply for scholarships from organisations such as the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE), the Environment and Conservation Fund, and the Hong Kong Jockey Club.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3375 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Master the Weighting Formula**
- Focus on subjects with higher weighting: English, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics, and M1/M2. A 5** in Mathematics (weighted 1.5) is worth more than a 5** in an elective with standard weighting.
- Use PolyU’s online admission calculator to simulate your weighted score. Aim for a score above 180 to be safe, given the 2025 average of 178.4.
**2. Prioritise Core STEM Subjects**
- Take at least two science electives (Chemistry and Physics are strongly preferred). Biology or Combined Science can also be considered but may have slightly lower weighting.
- If you are strong in Mathematics, consider taking M1 or M2 to boost your weighted score further.
**3. Prepare for the Interview**
- Research current environmental issues in Hong Kong, such as the Waste Blueprint, climate action plan, and the Greater Bay Area’s green development.
- Practise articulating why you want to study environmental engineering and how you can contribute to sustainable development. Be specific about your interests.
**4. Build a Strong Portfolio**
- Participate in environmental competitions like the Hong Kong Student Science Project Competition or the PolyU Innovation Cup. Winning or participating adds weight to your application.
- Volunteer for beach clean-ups, tree planting, or join green groups like Greenpeace Hong Kong or WWF. Document your experiences for the interview.
**5. Ace Your HKDSE English**
- English is heavily weighted. Aim for at least Level 5. Practice writing argumentative essays on environmental topics, and improve your speaking fluency for the interview.
- Use resources like the South China Morning Post’s environment section to build vocabulary and awareness.
**6. Leverage the 6th Subject Bonus**
- If you take a 6th subject (e.g., another elective or an Applied Learning course), you can earn bonus points. Even a Level 3 in a 6th subject can add 2–3 points to your weighted score.
- Choose a 6th subject that complements your profile, such as Geography (for environmental context) or Economics (for sustainability policy).
**7. Understand the Programme’s Focus**
- JS3375 blends engineering with sustainable development. Highlight in your personal statement or interview how you see the link between technology and policy.
- Read about PolyU’s research in areas like smart city waste management and renewable energy integration. Mentioning specific projects shows genuine interest.
**8. Apply Early and Check Requirements**
- Submit your JUPAS application by the early deadline (typically December). Late applications may still be considered but with lower priority.
- Double-check that you meet the minimum subject requirements: English Level 3, Mathematics Level 2, and one science subject Level 2 (Chemistry, Physics, or Biology).
**9. Consider the Greater Bay Area Advantage**
- PolyU has strong ties with the Greater Bay Area. Mention your interest in cross-border environmental projects, such as the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao climate collaboration.
- If you speak Mandarin or Cantonese, highlight this as an asset for working in the GBA. The programme includes opportunities for internships in Shenzhen and Guangzhou.

admission.title: 入學要求與計分詳情 (DSE)
content: **入學計分公式**：任何最佳五科 (另加第6科加分)。
**文憑試成績平均積點（計算科目比重後）**：178.4（2025年聯招數據）。
**入學中位數**：N/A分（2025年聯招數據）。
**下四分位數**：N/A分（2025年聯招數據）。
**科目比重**：Subject weighting in details。
**核心科目最低要求**：中國語文第3級、英國語文第3級、數學（必修部分）第2級、公民與社會發展科達標。
**選修科目**：任何2科達第3級。
**面試**：標準聯招入學不需要面試。
**修讀年期**：4年全日制。
**首年學費**：港幣44,500元（本地學生）。
**備註**：科目比重詳見「比重」按鈕。

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: **課程概覽**：環境工程及可持續發展學(榮譽)工學士（JS3375）為四年全日制課程，隸屬於建設及環境學院，專注於環境保護、污染控制及可持續基建。
**第一年 – 基礎科目**：學生修讀數學、化學、物理、工程力學及環境工程導論等核心科目，並包含大學共同核心課程（GUR）。
**第二年 – 核心專業**：主要課程包括水與廢水工程、空氣污染控制、固體廢物管理、環境微生物學及水文學。學生開始進行實驗室學習。
**第三年 – 專業深化與實習**：進階課題包括環境影響評估、可再生能源系統、可持續設計及綠色建築。學生須完成強制性的「工作綜合教育」（WIE）實習。
**第四年 – 畢業專題與選修**：畢業專題針對真實環境挑戰進行研究，並可選修環境工程或可持續發展兩個方向。學生亦需修讀專業倫理單元。
**專業認證**：本課程獲香港工程師學會（HKIE）認可，畢業生可邁向特許工程師資格。

career.title: 就業前景
content: **環境工程師**：設計及監督污染控制系統、污水處理廠及廢物管理設施，服務於公私營機構。
**可持續發展顧問**：為企業及政府機構提供碳減排策略、ESG報告及綠色建築認證（如BEAM Plus、LEED）的諮詢服務。
**政府工程師**：加入環境保護署或渠務署擔任見習工程師，參與香港環境基建項目。
**研究人員／學者**：在理大或海外大學攻讀哲學碩士／博士，專注於空氣質素建模、可再生能源或氣候變化適應等領域。
**項目經理**：領導大型環境項目，任職於Arup、AECOM或Mott MacDonald等工程顧問公司，尤其在大灣區發展。
**綠色建築專家**：與發展商及建築師合作，將可持續設計原則融入新建及翻新項目。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **優越地理位置**：理大位於九龍紅磡，毗鄰紅磡港鐵站（東鐵線及屯馬線），交通便利，覆蓋全港各區。
**先進實驗室**：學生可使用專屬環境工程實驗室，包括水與廢水實驗室、空氣質素實驗室及環境微生物實驗室。
**可持續發展樞紐**：校內的賽馬會創新樓及新建的理大大樓設有綠色屋頂、節能系統，並作為可持續設計的活實驗室。
**學生組織**：加入理大環境工程學會，參與污水處理廠、回收中心及環保公園的實地考察，以及業界交流活動。
**體育與康樂**：校園設有體育中心，配備游泳池、健身室、多用途球場及標誌性的理大體育館。學生可參加超過100個學會及社團。
**全球交流**：理大與全球超過400所院校合作。環境工程學生可到英國、澳洲、加拿大或內地的大學進行一學期交換。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學要求
content: **入學分數計算**：最佳5科（另加第6科獎勵分）。課程以最佳5科HKDSE成績計算，並為第6科提供額外獎勵分，鼓勵學生廣泛選修。
**科目權重**：核心科目（英文、數學、通識）及選修科如化學、物理、生物、M1/M2獲較高權重。具體權重詳情請參閱理大招生網站。
**2025年平均加權分數**：2025年入學的平均加權HKDSE分數為178.4分。申請人應以此為基準評估自身競爭力。
**無公布中位數/下四分位數**：由於課程較新或數據有限，2025年的中位數及下四分位數暫未提供。申請人應爭取加權分數高於178分以增加競爭力。
**面試要求**：獲篩選的申請人可能獲邀面試，評估其學習動機、對環境議題的理解及溝通能力。面試表現優秀可提高錄取機會。

alumni.title: 知名校友與成功故事
content: **陳國強教授 (Ir Dr. Albert Chan)**：理大建設及環境學院前院長，建築廢物管理及可持續建築領域的知名研究學者，畢業於理大環境工程課程。
**許志堅博士 (Ir Dr. Sam Hui)**：理大副教授，建築能源效益及可再生能源專家，屢獲教學獎項，領導可持續建築研究組。
**黎志強博士 (Ir Dr. Joseph Lai)**：理大屋宇設備工程學系副系主任，專注室內空氣質素及能源表現，發表逾100篇研究論文。
**何志強博士 (Ir Dr. Daniel Ho)**：AECOM香港技術總監，領導大型基建項目的環境影響評估，理大環境工程畢業生。
**鄭振華博士 (Ir Dr. Vincent Cheng)**：香港環境保護署總工程師，負責空氣質素監測及政策實施，理大校友。
**余偉強博士 (Ir Dr. William Yu)**：綠色科技初創公司創辦人兼行政總裁，專注淨水系統，獲選香港傑出青年企業家，理大畢業生。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與經濟援助
content: **理大入學獎學金**：頒予HKDSE成績優異者（如多科5**），涵蓋首年全額或部分學費，並可按學業成績續領。
**建設及環境學院獎學金**：專為學院學生而設，根據HKDSE成績及面試表現頒發，金額約10,000至30,000港元。
**環境工程課程獎學金**：由業界夥伴（如Arup、渠務署）捐贈，頒予學業成績優異且對環境可持續發展有承擔的學生。
**工作綜合教育（WIE）津貼**：為參與無薪實習的學生提供經濟支援，確保所有學生不論經濟背景均可獲得寶貴工作經驗。
**政府學生資助**：合資格學生可申請香港特區政府的「擴展的免入息審查貸款計劃」（ENLS）及經入息審查的資助/補助金（學生資助處）。
**外部獎學金**：鼓勵學生申請香港工程師學會（HKIE）、環境及自然保育基金及香港賽馬會等機構提供的獎學金。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3375 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 掌握權重計算公式**
- 集中火力於權重較高的科目：英文、數學、化學、物理及M1/M2。數學考獲5**（權重1.5）比選修科5**（標準權重）更有價值。
- 使用理大網上入學計算器模擬你的加權分數。鑑於2025年平均分為178.4，目標應設定在180分以上以確保安全。
**2. 優先修讀核心STEM科目**
- 至少選修兩科科學（化學及物理為首選）。生物或組合科學亦可考慮，但權重可能稍低。
- 若數學成績優異，可考慮修讀M1或M2，進一步提升加權分數。
**3. 為面試做好準備**
- 研究香港當前的環境議題，例如《廢物藍圖》、氣候行動計劃及大灣區綠色發展。
- 練習清晰表達為何想修讀環境工程，以及如何為可持續發展作出貢獻。具體說明你的興趣所在。
**4. 建立豐富的個人檔案**
- 參加環境相關比賽，如香港學生科學比賽或理大創新盃。獲獎或參賽經歷可為申請加分。
- 參與沙灘清潔、植樹活動，或加入綠色和平、世界自然基金會等環保組織。記錄你的經歷以便面試時分享。
**5. 在HKDSE英文科取得佳績**
- 英文科權重高，目標至少達第5級。多練習撰寫關於環境議題的議論文，並提升面試口語流暢度。
- 利用《南華早報》的環境版塊累積詞彙及增進認知。
**6. 善用第6科獎勵分**
- 若修讀第6科（如另一選修科或應用學習課程），可獲獎勵分。即使第6科僅獲第3級，也能為加權分數增加2至3分。
- 選擇與個人背景互補的第6科，例如地理（提供環境背景）或經濟（涉及可持續政策）。
**7. 了解課程重點**
- JS3375融合工程與可持續發展。在個人陳述或面試中，強調你如何看待科技與政策之間的聯繫。
- 閱讀理大在智慧城市廢物管理及可再生能源整合等領域的研究。提及具體項目能顯示你的真誠興趣。
**8. 提早申請並核實要求**
- 在早期截止日期（通常為12月）前提交JUPAS申請。逾期申請仍可能獲考慮，但優先次序較低。
- 確保符合最低科目要求：英文第3級、數學第2級及一科科學（化學、物理或生物）第2級。
**9. 把握大灣區優勢**
- 理大與大灣區聯繫緊密。在申請中提及你對跨境環境項目（如粵港澳氣候合作）的興趣。
- 若你精通普通話或粵語，可將其視為在大灣區工作的優勢。課程提供深圳及廣州的實習機會。
